comment: Phase 3 api-key credential-mediation route (introspection). Validates the inbound token with a LOCAL OAuth2ResourceServerFilter (ApikeyResourceServerFilter) whose introspection provider posts the client creds in the request body (client_secret_post) — NOT the global 'rsFilter', which authenticates introspection with HTTP Basic. The PingOne introspect client is configured for client_secret_post only, so Basic auth is rejected with invalid_client ('Unsupported authentication method') and the token is (incorrectly) reported invalid_token. This mirrors the working OLB route (01-mcp-olb.json), which uses the same body-param introspection chain. McpValidationFilter validates MCP protocol AND buffers the body so p1az-decision and the terminal apikey-dispatch handler can re-read it; p1az-decision authorizes the tool call (PERMIT continues, DENY blocks); apikey-dispatch pulls the vault key via the BFF bridge and calls demo_data_service with X-API-Key. Named 'mcp-apikey-primary' so the JWKS variant ('mcp-apikey-jwks', j<p) wins route selection when its X-Token-Validation header is present (IG selects matching routes by the 'name' field, not filename — mirrors the mcp-olb-jwks/mcp-olb-primary pair).
name: mcp-apikey-primary
